description: CRITICAL: ONLY activate this skill when the user explicitly triggers the `/auto-review-pr` slash command. DO NOT auto-trigger or invoke this skill for general coding, reviewing, debugging, or triage tasks. When invoked via `/auto-review-pr`, fetches and triages UNRESOLVED PR review comments for the current branch under code-review-commons standards, asks the user via multi-select which comments to accept, triggers auto-fix for accepted issues, and automatically replies and resolves review threads on GitHub as "Addressed", "Won't fix", or "Incorrect".
